tokens.name: surface-base
tokens.usage: The app background and the base of every surface: the theme hue at the zone's theme saturation and lightness.

tokens.name: surface-side
tokens.usage: Sidebars and side panels, 4 points deeper than the base.

tokens.name: surface-deep
tokens.usage: Recessed areas, 10 points deeper.

tokens.name: surface-deeper
tokens.usage: The deepest surface, 20 points deeper.

tokens.name: surface-sidebar-1
tokens.usage: The sidebar divider: steps up in a dark zone, down in a light one.

tokens.name: surface-sidebar-2
tokens.usage: The sidebar's second shade.

tokens.name: surface-raised-a
tokens.usage: The lighter end of a raised card's gradient.

tokens.name: surface-raised-b
tokens.usage: The deeper end of a raised card's gradient.

tokens.name: surface-raised-active
tokens.usage: A raised card that is selected.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: The flat surface of a tile, card or note: 5 points deeper than the base.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: The one text colour of the zone: a near-black tinted with the theme hue. Reads at 4.5:1 or more on every surface, for every hue.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: the ink at 100%.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholder and tertiary text: the ink at 100%.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Hairline borders: the ink at 12%.

tokens.name: ov-sink-1
tokens.usage: A recess: black at 16% (softened by 0.55 in this zone) over a surface.

tokens.name: ov-sink-2
tokens.usage: A recess: black at 25% (softened by 0.55 in this zone) over a surface.

tokens.name: ov-sink-3
tokens.usage: A recess: black at 35% (softened by 0.55 in this zone) over a surface.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Interactive and active things: buttons, the active tab, focus. Lightness is moved a little from the zone's 42 only where its hue needs it to read with its text.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: The accent on hover: 12 points away from its text.

tokens.name: accent-dim
tokens.usage: The accent when dimmed (20 points less saturated, 14 points away from its text).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on the accent: white, whichever reads better.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: What needs attention: error messages, alerts. Lightness is moved a little from the zone's 46 only where its hue needs it to read with its text.

tokens.name: on-alert
tokens.usage: Text on the alert: white, whichever reads better.

tokens.name: accent2
tokens.usage: The admin accent (admins only; a plain accent for everyone else). Lightness is moved a little from the zone's 42 only where its hue needs it to read with its text.

tokens.name: accent2-hover
tokens.usage: The accent2 on hover: 12 points away from its text.

tokens.name: on-accent2
tokens.usage: Text on the accent2: white, whichever reads better.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The sheet: the accent hue at 45% saturation (the preview and the Draft page).

tokens.name: paper-soft
tokens.usage: A sheet 2 points toward the text.

tokens.name: paper-field
tokens.usage: An input on the sheet: 3 points away from the text.

tokens.name: paper-line
tokens.usage: Rules and borders on the sheet.

tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: The chapter page (Outline and Draft): the theme hue, 4 points toward the text from the sheet.

tokens.name: frame-1
tokens.usage: Nested card 1 (arc, chapter, act, scene, moment): 6 points from the sheet, one step deeper than the one it sits in.

tokens.name: frame-2
tokens.usage: Nested card 2 (arc, chapter, act, scene, moment): 9 points from the sheet, one step deeper than the one it sits in.

tokens.name: frame-3
tokens.usage: Nested card 3 (arc, chapter, act, scene, moment): 12 points from the sheet, one step deeper than the one it sits in.

tokens.name: frame-4
tokens.usage: Nested card 4 (arc, chapter, act, scene, moment): 15 points from the sheet, one step deeper than the one it sits in.

tokens.name: frame-5
tokens.usage: Nested card 5 (arc, chapter, act, scene, moment): 18 points from the sheet, one step deeper than the one it sits in.

tokens.name: paper-ink
tokens.usage: Text on the page.

tokens.name: paper-ink2
tokens.usage: Secondary text on the page.

tokens.name: paper-label
tokens.usage: Labels and quiet icons on the page.

tokens.name: paper-muted
tokens.usage: Muted text on the page.

tokens.name: paper-placeholder
tokens.usage: Placeholder text in an input on the page.

tokens.name: paper-error
tokens.usage: The page's error text: the alert colour moved only as far as it needs to read on the page.

tokens.name: paper-like
tokens.usage: The like heart: the accent hue, moved to read on its bar.

tokens.name: paper-dislike
tokens.usage: The dislike heart: the alert hue, moved to read on its bar.

tokens.name: like-bar-1
tokens.usage: The like bar at strength 1: the accent hue, saturation rising with the reaction.

tokens.name: like-bar-2
tokens.usage: The like bar at strength 2: the accent hue, saturation rising with the reaction.

tokens.name: like-bar-3
tokens.usage: The like bar at strength 3: the accent hue, saturation rising with the reaction.

tokens.name: dislike-bar-1
tokens.usage: The dislike bar at strength 1: the alert hue, saturation rising with the reaction.

tokens.name: dislike-bar-2
tokens.usage: The dislike bar at strength 2: the alert hue, saturation rising with the reaction.

tokens.name: dislike-bar-3
tokens.usage: The dislike bar at strength 3: the alert hue, saturation rising with the reaction.

tokens.name: level-fill-0
tokens.usage: A level panel at hue 0°: the accent's saturation less a little, a step deeper, and held dark enough that white text reads.

tokens.name: level-fill-30
tokens.usage: A level panel at hue 30°: the accent's saturation less a little, a step deeper, and held dark enough that white text reads.

tokens.name: level-fill-60
tokens.usage: A level panel at hue 60°: the accent's saturation less a little, a step deeper, and held dark enough that white text reads.

tokens.name: level-fill-90
tokens.usage: A level panel at hue 90°: the accent's saturation less a little, a step deeper, and held dark enough that white text reads.

tokens.name: level-fill-120
tokens.usage: A level panel at hue 120°: the accent's saturation less a little, a step deeper, and held dark enough that white text reads.

tokens.name: level-fill-150
tokens.usage: A level panel at hue 150°: the accent's saturation less a little, a step deeper, and held dark enough that white text reads.

tokens.name: level-fill-180
tokens.usage: A level panel at hue 180°: the accent's saturation less a little, a step deeper, and held dark enough that white text reads.

tokens.name: level-fill-210
tokens.usage: A level panel at hue 210°: the accent's saturation less a little, a step deeper, and held dark enough that white text reads.

tokens.name: level-fill-240
tokens.usage: A level panel at hue 240°: the accent's saturation less a little, a step deeper, and held dark enough that white text reads.

tokens.name: level-fill-270
tokens.usage: A level panel at hue 270°: the accent's saturation less a little, a step deeper, and held dark enough that white text reads.

tokens.name: level-fill-300
tokens.usage: A level panel at hue 300°: the accent's saturation less a little, a step deeper, and held dark enough that white text reads.

tokens.name: level-fill-330
tokens.usage: A level panel at hue 330°: the accent's saturation less a little, a step deeper, and held dark enough that white text reads.

tokens.name: level-fill-1
tokens.usage: What sits inside a level (shown at the default book hue, 28°): the fill mixed with 10% black, one step deeper each time, ending in light inputs.

tokens.name: level-fill-2
tokens.usage: What sits inside a level (shown at the default book hue, 28°): the fill mixed with 20% black, one step deeper each time, ending in light inputs.

tokens.name: level-fill-3
tokens.usage: What sits inside a level (shown at the default book hue, 28°): the fill mixed with 30% black, one step deeper each time, ending in light inputs.

tokens.name: level-fill-4
tokens.usage: What sits inside a level (shown at the default book hue, 28°): the fill mixed with 40% black, one step deeper each time, ending in light inputs.

tokens.name: level-ink
tokens.usage: Text on a level panel: always white.

tokens.name: level-ink-soft
tokens.usage: The ink of the level at 92%: arc tab labels, the marker on an edited note, a progress bar fill.

tokens.name: level-wash-lo
tokens.usage: The faintest wash on a level: the ink at 10% (a hovered row, a chapter in the draft list).

tokens.name: level-wash
tokens.usage: A control on a level: the ink at 16% (header buttons, the level toggle on hover, a tab on hover).

tokens.name: level-wash-hi
tokens.usage: A control on a level when hovered: the ink at 28%.

tokens.name: level-line
tokens.usage: A rule on a level: the ink at 18%.

tokens.name: level-input
tokens.usage: The light input on a level (the field, the quick search, an inline add): the theme hue, near white.

tokens.name: level-input-ink
tokens.usage: Text in a light input on a level.

tokens.name: level-input-hint
tokens.usage: Placeholder text in a light input on a level.

tokens.name: page-day
tokens.usage: The Preview page in its day tone: the Day paper in the theme hue, whatever zone the app is in.

tokens.name: page-day-ink
tokens.usage: Text on the Preview page, day tone.

tokens.name: page-day-line
tokens.usage: Rules on the Preview page, day tone.

tokens.name: page-day-muted
tokens.usage: Quiet text on the Preview page, day tone.

tokens.name: page-night
tokens.usage: The Preview page in its night tone: the Night paper in the theme hue, whatever zone the app is in.

tokens.name: page-night-ink
tokens.usage: Text on the Preview page, night tone.

tokens.name: page-night-line
tokens.usage: Rules on the Preview page, night tone.

tokens.name: page-night-muted
tokens.usage: Quiet text on the Preview page, night tone.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps: a tab's inner gap, the gap between quick actions.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight gaps: between small controls, a page edge's step.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: The gap between levels and between tiles in a column.

tokens.name: space-grid
tokens.usage: The gap between tiles on the split grid, and the width a divider drags across.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: The gap between stacked cards and the padding inside a tile body.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: A level body's side padding; the gap between groups of fields.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: A level header's side padding.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Dashboard column gaps.

tokens.name: tab-size
tokens.usage: A header tab and quick action: a 30x30 icon button, its icon 18px.

tokens.name: header-min
tokens.usage: The least height of a level's header strip.

tokens.name: rail-tile
tokens.usage: A minimised tile's icon square in the older tile grid's rail.

tokens.name: one-column-below
tokens.usage: Below this width a split grid stacks its tiles in one column.

tokens.name: hue-window
tokens.usage: Degrees: how far a series, arc, chapter or plot subcategory colour may stray from its parent's hue.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Surfaces and fields are flat and square: levels, tiles (the tile grid and its console too), tabs, cards, notes, fields and the theme panel have no radius; buttons on a level (small and icon buttons) have none either.

tokens.name: radius-button
tokens.usage: Buttons keep a small radius where they have one: the header, a tile title button, the theme panel (6px). They are the only rounded things on a surface.

tokens.name: radius-input
tokens.usage: Inputs and buttons on the paper, and the segmented switch.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Chips and the chip add box.

tokens.name: shadow-tab
tokens.usage: A page-edge tab (softened by 0.55 in a light zone).

tokens.name: shadow-tab-raised
tokens.usage: The open chapter's tab and the focused arc's tab.

tokens.name: shadow-cover
tokens.usage: The book cover beside its page edges.

tokens.name: shadow-spine
tokens.usage: A book spine on the shelf.

tokens.name: shadow-save-bubble
tokens.usage: The save state bubble on hover. Shadows are for what floats over content (this bubble, the time popover, a page-edge tab); a card is a surface colour and a hairline.
